# Deep Web Research

## Procedure
Triangulate independent sources; timestamp findings; separate observations from model inference; do not invent Google Trends scores or browsed results.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
